description: Search the NCEI Storm Events Database for one calendar year — tornadoes, hail, floods, hurricanes, winter storms, heat, and every other NWS Storm Data event type, with magnitude, direct and indirect casualties, property and crop damage, and narratives. This corpus carries discrete severe-weather events rather than CDO station observations, needs no token, and publishes one bulk file per year, so year is required. Filter by episodeId from a returned event, state (full NCEI name such as "FLORIDA", not "FL"), eventType (exact NWS label such as "Tornado", "Flash Flood", or "Hurricane (Typhoon)", case-insensitive), month, and minDamageInUsd. Damage retains its raw magnitude-suffixed cell and parsed dollar amount; unreported figures are omitted, and minDamageInUsd discloses how many unknown figures it excluded. Events reference distinct page-local episodeNarratives by episodeNarrativeRef; eventNarrative stays on each event. Optional local ISO beginDate/endDate values can feed CDO date filters; raw NCEI date-time and timezone remain available. Source row order, limit/offset pagination, and whole-year filtered totalCount are preserved.

episodeId.description: Exact EPISODE_ID from a returned event. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; blank means no filter. Leading zeros are significant. Keep year supplied.

eventType.description: Filter to this NWS event type, matched case-insensitively against the exact label (e.g. "Tornado", "Hail", "Flash Flood", "Hurricane (Typhoon)"). A miss returns the labels present in that year. Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1–100). Defaults to 50.

minDamageInUsd.description: Filter to events whose property damage parses to at least this many dollars. Excludes every row whose damage NCEI did not report — about a fifth of a recent year — since an unreported figure cannot be shown to clear the threshold. Optional.

month.description: Filter to events whose begin date falls in this month (1–12). Optional.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first matching event to return. Defaults to 0.

state.description: Filter to this state or territory, written as the full name NCEI uses (e.g. "FLORIDA", "PUERTO RICO"), matched case-insensitively. Postal codes like "FL" match nothing. Optional.

year.description: Calendar year to search (1950 through the current partial year). Required — NCEI publishes one file per year, so an unscoped search would download every year back to 1950.

name: noaa_climate_search_storm_events

cap.description: The limit that was applied. Omitted otherwise.

episodeNarratives.description: Each distinct episode narrative on this page, once; referenced by events[].episodeNarrativeRef.

items.description: One distinct episode narrative on this page.

text.description: Distinct nonblank episode narrative text, preserved from the service.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `year_unavailable`: The NCEI directory listing has no details file for the requested year. `service_unavailable`: The NCEI bulk file server would not hand back a usable file: the directory index is unreachable or carried no details files, the year bundle it names is gone, or the downloaded bundle did not decompress. `malformed_export`: The year decompressed but is not the expected table — required columns are missing, or the file carried no rows. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

events.description: Matching events for the requested page, in the source file’s own row order.

beginDate.description: Local ISO calendar start date (YYYY-MM-DD), usable with CDO date filters. Omitted when source components are missing or invalid.

beginDateTime.description: Event start as NCEI writes it, e.g. "30-APR-24 20:33:00".

beginLatitude.description: Latitude of the event start in decimal degrees. Omitted when absent.

beginLongitude.description: Longitude of the event start in decimal degrees. Omitted when absent.

countyOrZone.description: County/parish or NWS forecast zone name. Omitted when not provided.

countyOrZoneType.description: Whether countyOrZone is a county ("C") or an NWS forecast zone ("Z"). Omitted when not provided.

damageCrops.description: Crop damage. Omitted when NCEI reported no figure.

amountInUsd.description: Dollar value parsed from raw. Omitted when the cell did not parse (the live files carry a few malformed cells such as a bare "K"); the raw text is still returned.

raw.description: The upstream cell verbatim, e.g. "0.00K", "1.20M", "1.00B" — never rewritten.

damageProperty.description: Property damage. Omitted when NCEI reported no figure.

amountInUsd.description: Dollar value parsed from raw. Omitted when the cell did not parse (the live files carry a few malformed cells such as a bare "K"); the raw text is still returned.

raw.description: The upstream cell verbatim, e.g. "0.00K", "1.20M", "1.00B" — never rewritten.

deathsDirect.description: Deaths caused directly by the event. Omitted when not reported.

deathsIndirect.description: Deaths indirectly attributed to the event. Omitted when not reported.

endDate.description: Local ISO calendar end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when source components are missing or invalid; not a UTC conversion.

endDateTime.description: Event end. Omitted when not provided.

episodeId.description: NCEI EPISODE_ID grouping events from one storm system. Omitted for pre-1996 records, which carry no episode.

episodeNarrativeRef.description: Reference to this page’s episodeNarratives text. Omitted when no narrative was reported.

eventId.description: NCEI EVENT_ID — unique within the Storm Events corpus.

eventNarrative.description: Narrative for this individual event. Omitted when absent.

floodCause.description: Reported flood cause, e.g. "Heavy Rain". Omitted for non-flood events.

injuriesDirect.description: Injuries caused directly by the event. Omitted when not reported.

injuriesIndirect.description: Injuries indirectly attributed to the event. Omitted when not reported.

magnitude.description: Wind speed in knots or hail size in inches, depending on the event type — NCEI populates it only for wind and hail events. Omitted otherwise.

magnitudeType.description: How a wind magnitude was determined: "EG" estimated gust, "ES" estimated sustained, "MG" measured gust, "MS" measured sustained. Omitted for non-wind events.

source.description: Who reported the event, e.g. "ASOS", "Trained Spotter". Omitted when absent.

state.description: Full upper-case state or territory name, e.g. "FLORIDA".

timezone.description: Local time zone of the date fields, e.g. "CST-6". Omitted when absent.

torFScale.description: Tornado intensity — Enhanced Fujita ("EF1", or "EFU" when unrated) from 2007 on, original Fujita ("F3") before that. Omitted for non-tornado events.

torLengthInMiles.description: Tornado track length in miles. Omitted for non-tornado events.

torWidthInYards.description: Tornado track width in yards. Omitted for non-tornado events.

excludedUnknownDamage.description: Rows that satisfied every other filter but were dropped by minDamageInUsd because NCEI reported no property-damage figure for them. Omitted when minDamageInUsd was not supplied.

exhausted.description: True when offset is past the end of a non-empty match set — the page is empty but matches exist. Omitted otherwise.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched or the page ran past the end. Omitted otherwise.

scannedRowCount.description: Rows read from the source file, matched or not. Omitted when unavailable.

shown.description: Events returned on this page. Omitted otherwise.

sourceFile.description: The exact NCEI file this page was read from, including its `_c<publishDate>` suffix — the suffix changes whenever NCEI republishes a year.

totalCount.description: Events matching every filter across the whole year, before offset and limit.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist beyond this page. Omitted otherwise.
